name: Sdet Resume Catalog
headline: SDET Resume Catalog: Resume Templates by Industry
short_description: A community-curated catalog of automation-testing resume templates, organized by industry sector with contributor profiles and core skills.
author: Test-Architect

sections.overview:
The SDET Resume Catalog is a curated collection of automation testing resume templates organized across 13 major industry sectors, from Technology and Finance to Healthcare and Aerospace. Currently featuring a completed mobile testing resume example for Google, the catalog shows contributor profiles and core skills for each template. The resource is designed to help automation testing professionals and SDETs build industry-relevant resumes by providing real examples tailored to different sectors. As a community-driven project, it includes pending templates for Finance, Healthcare, Retail, Automotive, Energy, Telecommunications, Logistics, Manufacturing, Consulting, Media, and Hospitality industries.
Browse mobile testing resume examples for tech companies like Google
Find industry-specific SDET resume templates by sector
View contributor profiles and core skills for automation testing roles
Reference completed resume formats for job applications

Generate a resume template for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) specializing in [INDUSTRY] automation. Include sections for core skills, tools, and experience with [TOOLS]. Format it as a clean, modern resume with bullet points and clear headings.
